visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-bleed homepage hero with background photo, H1 and a row of icon quick-link CTAs

sources.style: Background image hero with dark navy angled overlay; H1 white ~48px; three equal white button-cards with small icons, overlapping the bottom edge.
sources.stylingNotes: Full-width hero: background photo (group of people in a circle) on a dark navy diagonal overlay, white H1 'Advanced care. Focused on you.', and three white quick-link buttons with icons (Find a Doctor, Make an Appointment, Find a Location and Parking).

contentPattern.structure: row 1: background image; row 2: H1 followed by quick links (one per paragraph, optional :icon: before each label)
contentPattern.description: Background image, H1 heading and three icon quick-link CTAs (Find a Doctor, Make an Appointment, Find a Location and Parking)

usage: Top-of-page hero with a heading and 2-4 primary task links (e.g. Find a Doctor, Make an Appointment, Find a Location).
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any hero that pairs a background image and heading with a set of quick-link cards; use plain hero when CTAs are ordinary buttons.
